title: 2026-09-09 Project Task and System Updates
conciseSummary: The meeting on September 9, 2026, involved updates on various project tasks by attendees including Shaun, Mike, and Jacob. Key points included the sharing of a wire guard fix code by Shaun, the need for site verification with the customer team, and discussions about equipment condition post-fire. Radio testing was completed, resolving a previous 911 issue, while recorder connections and network setups were established. RapidSOS credential requests were submitted, with an anticipated confirmation delay of 1-2 weeks potentially affecting scheduling. Network troubleshooting revealed issues with IP connectivity, which have since been addressed. Action items were assigned to ensure the deletion of existing contacts, follow-up on IP status, escalation of RapidSOS requests, coordination of call routing, and ongoing monitoring of network issues.

## Project/Task Updates:
1 Update 1: Wire Guard Fix and Code Upload
   - Shaun shared wire guard fix code in chat.
   - Christian was supposed to start uploading it.
   - Clarified that the fix was for engine, not web.
   - Reminder to delete existing contacts before uploading new ones.

2 Update 2: Site Verification and Equipment Use
   - Site verification check planned with customer team on Sunday.
   - Discussion about needing a bus and borrowing tools like a banjo and butt set.
   - Equipment condition after fire discussed; some tools water-damaged but usable.

3 Update 3: Radio Testing and 911 Issue Resolution
   - Radio testing completed.
   - 911 issue earlier in the morning has subsided.
   - Ready to start testing shortly after resolving the issue.

4 Update 4: Recorder Connection and Network Setup
   - Recorder connections established.
   - Discussion about port assignments on recorder (ports 1 and 2 used, port 3 cable present, port 4 unused).
   - IP addresses for recorder and network devices shared.
   - Clarification needed on span port vs SIP recording setup.

5 Update 5: RapidSOS Credentials and Go-Live Scheduling
   - RapidSOS credential request submitted; expected 1-2 weeks for confirmation.
   - Suggestion to escalate process by calling support.
   - Go-live dates managed with backward and forward calculations.
   - Avoid scheduling conflicts for personnel across projects.

6 Update 6: Transition from Mevo to CPE and SBC Configurations
   - Mevo system in use; plans to move calls back to CPE.
   - SBC configurations updated to support call routing.
   - Coordination required before switching call routing.

7 Update 7: Network and System Issues Troubleshooting
   - B-side .77 IP reported down; investigation and restart performed.
   - Alley server for Huntsville had TCP connection errors; port correction fixed issue.
   - Internet connectivity issues reported and resolved.
   - Ongoing monitoring and troubleshooting by Jacob and team.

## Current Status:
- Status 1: Preliminary testing on site completed; waiting on one more resource to start full testing.
- Status 2: Radio testing and 911 issue resolved; recorder connections established; SBC and network configurations updated and verified.

## Key Metrics:
- Metric 1: Expected 1-2 weeks for RapidSOS credential confirmation.
- Metric 2: Estimated 10-15 minutes remaining for second position setup before cutover.

## Risks/Issues:
- Risk/Issue 1: Delay in RapidSOS credential confirmation could impact scheduling.
- Risk/Issue 2: Network connectivity issues and B-side .77 IP down causing temporary disruptions.

## Action Items:
- Task: Delete all existing contacts before uploading new contacts - Christian - ASAP
- Task: Follow up on B-side .77 IP status and investigate downtime - Shaun/Jacob - Immediate
- Task: Escalate RapidSOS credential request to speed up approval - Assigned to Tia - ASAP
- Task: Coordinate timing for moving calls from Mevo back to CPE - Matt/Mike - Before cutover
- Task: Verify recorder port assignments and IP configurations - Team (Michael, Eric, Jacob) - Before testing start
- Task: Continue monitoring and troubleshooting network and system issues - Jacob and team - Ongoing
